questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code validates the order request? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends delivery_type "asap" together with a scheduled_for timestamp. What happens?
choices: The timestamp is silently ignored and the order is placed
The request is rejected with 422 by the model validator before place_order runs
place_order rejects it with a 409 after looking up the restaurant
The order is converted to a scheduled delivery

questions.prompt: A request contains the same menu_item_id twice, each with quantity 15. What is the outcome?
choices: Accepted: each line is within the per-line limit of 20
Rejected with 422 by the PlaceOrder model before the route body runs
Rejected with 422 by the route after the restaurant is found open
Accepted with the quantities merged into 30

questions.prompt: A request with "quantity": "2" (a JSON string) for one item is submitted. What does the client see?
choices: The order is placed with quantity 2 because pydantic coerces numeric strings
A 422, because the field is declared strict and a string is not accepted as an int
A 400 from the HTTP server because the body is malformed
A 404 because the menu item cannot be matched
